description: Model-neutral target facts and microbenchmark evidence. Model-specific scale, penalties, coverage, gates, and fallback priors are intentionally excluded.

clock.sys_cnt.frequency_mhz.description: SYS_CNT counter frequency used to convert SYS_CNT cycles to wall-clock time and device-compute cycles.

clock.device_compute.frequency_mhz.description: Device compute clock from the local hardware/simulator configuration. It is not runtime telemetry from the measured A5 board and is used only for conditional clock-domain conversion.

simd.vector_width_bits.description: Physical SIMD vector width of one AIV, expressed in bits; FP32 lane count is width_bits / 32.

simt.warp_size.description: Number of scalar SIMT lanes that execute as one warp.

simd.f32.add.throughput.description: Effective source-level FP32 SIMD add throughput on one AIV for the tput.cce runtime-loop code shape. The numerator counts source vadd operations; loop/control/codegen overhead remains in elapsed cycles, so this is not a proven bare-ALU issue rate.

simd.f32.add.dependent_latency.description: Latency of one FP32 SIMD add in a dependent instruction chain on one AIV.

simt.f32.add.throughput.description: Effective source-level FP32 SIMT scalar-add throughput on one AIV for the tput.cce runtime-loop code shape. The numerator counts only source fadd operations while loop increment/compare/branch and codegen overhead remain in elapsed cycles; this is not a proven bare-ALU peak.

simt.setup.empty.description: Back-to-back async_invoke enqueue/launch-issue slope without a per-iteration barrier. The end counter is read before the final completion barrier, so this is not a completed empty-VF latency.

simt.setup.empty_with_barrier.description: Serialized empty-VF completion proxy with a per-iteration PIPE_ALL barrier. It includes async_invoke, one thread(0,0) UB write, barrier, and runtime-loop control; it is not a pure barrier or SIMD/SIMT transition latency.

simt.shuffle.throughput.description: Effective source-level FP32 shfl-up rate for the stated 32-warp ILP4 runtime-loop workload. Loop/control and sink overhead remain in elapsed cycles; this is not an intrinsic shuffle-pipeline peak.

simt.shuffle.dependent_latency.description: Effective FP32 dependent shfl-up chain iteration cost for the stated one-warp runtime-loop workload. It includes loop/control overhead and is not an isolated intrinsic latency.

simt.gm.load.throughput.description: Effective source GM-load rate for the stated 32-warp sequential rotating runtime-loop workload. Address generation, loop/control and the source sink remain in elapsed cycles; this is not an intrinsic LSU issue peak.

simt.gm.store.throughput.description: Effective source GM-store rate for the stated 32-warp sequential rotating runtime-loop workload. Address generation, value construction and loop/control remain in elapsed cycles; this is not an intrinsic LSU issue peak.

simt.gm.load.bandwidth.description: Effective single-AIV GM-load byte bandwidth for the stated workload; this is not whole-device theoretical HBM peak bandwidth.

simt.gm.store.bandwidth.description: Effective single-AIV GM-store byte bandwidth for the stated workload; this is not whole-device theoretical HBM peak bandwidth.

simt.ub.load.throughput.description: Effective source UB-load rate for the stated 32-warp rotating-set runtime-loop workload. Address, ALU and loop/control overhead remain in elapsed cycles.

simt.ub.store.throughput.description: Effective source UB-store rate for the stated 32-warp rotating-set runtime-loop workload. Address, ALU and loop/control overhead remain in elapsed cycles.

simt.ub.load.bandwidth.description: Effective single-AIV UB-load byte bandwidth for the stated workload.

simt.ub.store.bandwidth.description: Effective single-AIV UB-store byte bandwidth for the stated workload.

simt.setup.transition_harness_net.warps_.description: Standalone serialized empty-VF net setup proxy from the branch-heavy transition harness for one launched warp. It is mode1 minus barrier-only mode6 and does not contain a SIMD Stage, so it is neither a mixed transition nor a dependent handoff latency.

Standalone serialized empty-VF net setup proxy from the branch-heavy transition harness for two launched warps. It is mode1 minus barrier-only mode6 and does not contain a SIMD Stage, so it is neither a mixed transition nor a dependent handoff latency.

Standalone serialized empty-VF net setup proxy from the branch-heavy transition harness for four launched warps. It is mode1 minus barrier-only mode6 and does not contain a SIMD Stage, so it is neither a mixed transition nor a dependent handoff latency.

Standalone serialized empty-VF net setup proxy from the branch-heavy transition harness for eight launched warps. It is mode1 minus barrier-only mode6 and does not contain a SIMD Stage, so it is neither a mixed transition nor a dependent handoff latency.

Standalone serialized empty-VF net setup proxy from the branch-heavy transition harness for sixteen launched warps. It is mode1 minus barrier-only mode6 and does not contain a SIMD Stage, so it is neither a mixed transition nor a dependent handoff latency.

Standalone serialized empty-VF net setup proxy from the branch-heavy transition harness for thirty-two launched warps. It is mode1 minus barrier-only mode6 and does not contain a SIMD Stage, so it is neither a mixed transition nor a dependent handoff latency.

simd.scalar.load.throughput.description: Effective SIMD MainScalar scalar GM-load throughput measured by CCE scalar-path probe on Ascend 950PR. 8 independent scalar loads per inner iteration give about 0.154 scalar loads/system-cycle with the two-point slope method.

simd.scalar.load.direct_latency.description: Direct scalar load-use overhead component on SIMD/MainScalar derived from CCE probe: one load per iteration costs ~11.9 cycles; with 0.154 instr/cycle throughput this leaves ~5.4 cycles per-iteration overhead.

simd.scalar.store.throughput.description: Effective SIMD MainScalar scalar GM-store throughput measured by CCE scalar-path probe on Ascend 950PR. 8 independent scalar stores per inner iteration give about 0.166 scalar stores/system-cycle with the two-point slope method.

simd.scalar.store.direct_latency.description: Direct scalar store overhead component on SIMD/MainScalar derived from CCE probe: one store per iteration costs ~8.7 cycles; with 0.166 instr/cycle throughput this leaves ~2.7 cycles per-iteration overhead.

simt.scalar_gm.load.throughput.description: SIMT per-warp uniform-scalar GM load throughput measured by a dedicated CCE __simt_vf__ probe. All lanes in a warp read the same address; 32-warp one-op result is 0.19985 warp-instruction/system-cycle.

simt.scalar_gm.store.throughput.description: SIMT per-warp uniform-scalar GM store throughput measured by a dedicated CCE __simt_vf__ probe. All lanes in a warp write the same address; 32-warp one-op result is 0.3295 warp-instruction/system-cycle.
